plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: Rolling rows of silvery-green shrubs ripple with slender purple spikes. Each spike hums with bees and gives off a sweet, herbal perfume. Provence's lavender fields are among the most photographed summer scenes in the world.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring to late summer. In Provence, flowering runs from about June to early August, and fields around Sault bloom into August.
plants.funFact: Lavender oil has been prized since Roman times. The plant's name probably comes from the Latin 'lavare', meaning 'to wash', because the Romans scented their baths with it.

plants.name: Nelumbo nucifera
plants.description: Huge, cupped pink and white blooms rise on stiff stems above round, water-beading leaves. Each flower opens in the morning and closes at night, and lasts about three days. Ponds across Asia are at their most dramatic in high summer.
plants.bloomingSeason: Summer. Flowering is concentrated from June to August, which covers July 30.
plants.location: Ponds and lakes across East and South Asia, including China
plants.funFact: Lotus leaves have a micro-textured surface that sheds water and dirt in beads. This 'lotus effect' has inspired self-cleaning paints and fabrics.

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: South Africa's national flower is a bold, bowl-shaped bloom up to about 30 cm across. Its pink-tipped, silky bracts surround a central cushion of tiny flowers. It blooms in the southern winter and brings color to the fynbos of the Cape.
plants.bloomingSeason: Winter to spring, roughly July to October, so flowering is underway by July 30.
plants.location: Fynbos of the Western and Eastern Cape, South Africa
plants.funFact: Protea belongs to one of the oldest families of flowering plants. Its name comes from the Greek sea god Proteus, who could change shape, a nod to the many forms of the genus.

plants.name: Acacia pycnantha
plants.description: In the Australian winter, this small tree is covered in fluffy, golden, sweetly scented flower balls. They are arranged in showy sprays against its sickle-shaped leaf-like phyllodes. Their color lights up bushland and roadsides in the cool months.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to spring. Flowering runs from about July to October and usually peaks in July and August.
plants.funFact: Golden wattle is Australia's national floral emblem. National Wattle Day is celebrated on September 1.
